info.title: CV Match API
info.description: CV vs. job description analysis with background processing and Claude

matchScore.description: Overall fit of the candidate for the role, from 0 (no fit) to 100 (perfect fit).

summary.description: Three to five sentences for the recruiter summarising the fit, written in the language of the job description.

matchedSkills.description: Skills, tools or qualifications required by the job that the CV clearly demonstrates.

missingSkills.description: Skills, tools or qualifications required by the job that the CV does not show.

strengths.description: Concrete strengths of this candidate for this role.

gaps.description: Concrete gaps or risks relative to the job requirements.

redFlags.description: Inconsistencies, unexplained gaps, or claims worth verifying. Empty when none.

feedbackForCandidate.description: Actionable suggestions on how the candidate could improve the CV for this role.

interviewQuestions.description: Six to ten tailored interview questions covering every category.

rationale.description: Why this question matters for this candidate and role.
